track_fitting.stage: Rollers and axles, motor, housing and nominal idler fitted to both aligned tracks. Rear sprockets/hubs/journals, chains, joint fasteners and upper assembly absent.

sweep_evidence.method: Actual STEP boundary-face prisms plus the installed frame contain every translation between 0 and 80 mm vertical lift. Each retained prism is a valid solid with positive orientation; excluded faces have separating swept boxes or negligible volume. No sampled-pose interpolation is assumed.

track_service_routes.preparation: Support the chassis and affected track; park the upper at 0 degrees. Remove the affected chain, rear sprocket/hub/journal, all four joint fastener groups, and disconnect and secure that motor cable.
track_service_routes.route: Lower the prepared affected track vertically 80 mm, then move it outward horizontally. Do not pull it sideways while seated.
track_service_routes.frame_withdrawal_proof: Exact inverse relative motion of continuous_vertical_fitting.
track_service_routes.method: Conservative component AABB separating planes over the entire vertical drop, plus X/Z separation or a monotonic outward Y half-space for lateral departure. Full bound ARM60 reference at the parked pose is included.

rejected_lateral_track_fitting.reason: Straight lateral fitting causes real motor-can and housing interference. It is not an assembly route. The accepted vertical route is independently checked over its entire continuous motion, with no collision waiver.

central_axial_assembly.method: Installed interfaces checked statically. Translation away from these separating horizontal planes cannot create a frame collision.

fasteners.screw_entry: With its washer, lower the screw beside the arm, slide it sideways into the head slot (tip just short of the slot end), then advance into the plain bore.
fasteners.nut_loading: External nuts and washers. Fit and tighten with a 7 mm socket before installing the rear sprocket/hub and chain. Rollers and axles are already fitted. No nut/head recesses in the joint.
fasteners.tool: 3 mm L-key, approximately 20 mm short leg and 80 mm handle. Handle out of the side slot: swing from 30 degrees below to 30 degrees above horizontal, withdraw 3 mm and reset. Hold the external nut with a 7 mm socket from inside the track, with rollers fitted and the rear sprocket/chain absent.
fasteners.socket_envelope: 11.2 mm outer diameter and drive/handle/junction envelope, 7.1 mm AF cavity and 60 mm upright holding handle. Verify actual chosen tool dimensions.

scope: Exact nominal solid interference at the listed poses, with a complete continuous vertical frame-fitting sweep, continuous nut insertion and conservative60-degree L-key strokes, complete screw/socket insertion envelopes and continuous sprocket assembly sweeps.
